extra.final_summary:
Average flipper length by species (after cleaning): Adelie 190.18 mm, Chinstrap 199.64 mm, Gentoo 215.14 mm.

Data quality work:
- Read the rules file: flipper_length_mm must be in [170, 235] mm; species must be one of Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo.
- Checked the species column for label variants — clean, no misspellings or case variants.
- Found 3 rows (46, 47, 63) with impossible negative flipper lengths (-215, -228, -198). Excluded them from the analysis copy (approved); the original file is unchanged.
- The final averages use 61 of 64 rows.

Caveats: The island column has case/space variants ("torgersen", "Dream ") and body_mass_g has 3 numbers written as text, but neither affects this question, so they were left alone. Sex has 2 missing values, also irrelevant here.
